info.title: Mediflow API: planned endpoints
info.description: Endpoints the web app is built against that the API does not implement yet. Hand-written. When the API implements one, delete it here: the generated spec then provides it.

post.description: Opens a deep link to a record by its globally unique id. The server finds the hospital that owns the record, checks that the user is an active member of it, and rebinds the session to that hospital if another one (or none) is active. Every refusal is the same 403 link_unavailable, whether the record does not exist or belongs to a hospital the user does not work at, so a link cannot be used to find out what exists.

kind.description: The kind of record, e.g. notice.

200.description: The session, bound to the hospital that owns the record

get.description: Staff notices of the active tenant, newest first. Sample feature (F-13). Requires notice:read and the notices feature flag.

post.description: Archives a notice so it no longer appears in the list. Requires notice:manage.

get.description: Signed consents of one patient, newest first (MR-02, #190). Needs consent:read and the consents feature flag. The text and signature are in the single read.

post.description: Records a signed consent: the text as filled in from a version of a consent template, who signed, and the signature. Needs consent:sign. A signed consent is never changed or removed: there is no update or delete.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

get.description: One signed consent with its text and signature. Audited as a read of the patient record. Needs consent:read.
Certificates issued for one patient, newest first (MR-02, #190). Needs certificate:read and the consents feature flag.

post.description: Records a medical, fitness, birth or death certificate from the data entered. The server numbers it. Needs certificate:issue. An issued certificate is never changed or removed.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

get.description: Closed encounters whose record is not complete, with what is missing, the oldest first (MR-04, #192). Needs medicalRecord:read and the records feature flag. The server works out each gap from the encounter: an unsigned note, no diagnosis, no discharge summary for an inpatient stay, no signed consent for a procedure.
Diagnoses recorded as text that still have no code (state uncoded, the default), or coded ones, the oldest first (MR-04, #192). Needs medicalRecord:read and the records feature flag.

post.description: Gives a text diagnosis its ICD-10 code, at the version read. Needs medicalRecord:code. 409 version_conflict when the diagnosis changed, 422 when the code is not an ICD-10 code. Coding again replaces the code and is audited.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

get.description: The hospital's requests for copies of a record, the soonest due first (MR-04, #192). Needs recordRequest:read and the records feature flag.

post.description: Logs a request for a patient's record. Needs recordRequest:manage.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

post.description: Closes an open request as fulfilled or declined, with a note, at the version read; once only. Needs recordRequest:manage. 409 version_conflict or already_closed.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: A unique value chosen by the client; repeating the request with it returns the first result.

get.description: How a visit's charge ledger divides between the patient and the payer of the patient's active policy (IN-03, #183), worked out by the server: each charge at the payer's agreed rate, the plan's covered services, the limit per service, the patient's co-pay share and the sum insured. For every line payerMinor + patientMinor = ratedMinor, and ledgerMinor + rateAdjustmentMinor = payerMinor + patientMinor in total. Needs policy:read, charge:read and the insurance feature flag. 404 when the patient has no active policy. Audited.

post.description: Keeps the split as it is now, as the one the patient and payer bills are made from. A later change to the ledger makes the saved split stale (stale: true) until it is saved again. Needs policy:manage and charge:read. Idempotent by Idempotency-Key. Audited.

200.description: The split with the saved copy

get.description: Insurance claims, newest first, one cursor page. Needs claim:read.
Money still to come in on claims, by payer and by days since the claim was submitted. Needs claim:read.
One claim with its history. Needs claim:read.

post.description: Moves a claim along: submit, raise_query, reply, approve, reject, settle, write_off or cancel. Only the transitions of the claim state machine are allowed (409 invalid_transition otherwise). Needs claim:manage, and claim:writeoff for write_off.

Prepares a claim for a visit from the saved split: the payer share, the policy and the packet of documents (by name). One open claim per visit (409 claim_exists); nothing to claim is 422. Needs claim:manage.

get.description: Corporate credit accounts with what is billed, received and still owed, largest balance first, one cursor page. Needs receivable:read.
The credit account of a corporate. 404 when it has none. Needs receivable:read.

put.description: Opens the credit account of a corporate or changes its limit and terms; a change carries the version it started from (409 version_conflict). Only a corporate has one (422 not_corporate). A limit below what is already owed is 422 below_outstanding. Needs receivable:manage.

get.description: The bills put on a corporate account, oldest first, one cursor page. Needs receivable:read.

The statement of an account for a period: the balance before it, every bill and receipt in date order with the running balance, and the balance at the end, one cursor page of lines. The totals cover the whole period. Needs receivable:read.
The money received from a corporate, newest first, one cursor page. Needs receivable:read.

post.description: Records money received from a corporate and sets it against its oldest unpaid bills first. More than is owed is 422 exceeds_outstanding. Needs receivable:receipt.

201.description: The receipt with where it went

post.description: Bills the whole of a visit to a corporate credit account: the visit charge ledger, due after the account terms. One credit bill per visit (409 credit_bill_exists); nothing to bill is 422 nothing_to_bill; over the limit is 422 credit_limit_exceeded. Needs receivable:manage.

NoticePage.description: Cursor envelope used by every list endpoint.

signedByName.description: The member of staff who recorded the signature.

body.description: The text as it was signed: the rich text document of the app, placeholders filled in.

signature.description: SVG path data of a drawn signature in a 300 by 150 box; absent for a typed one.

number.description: Assigned by the server, in order for each kind and year.

fields.description: What was entered, by the field names of the kind.

ledgerMinor.description: The charge as posted, at the list price.

ratedMinor.description: The charge at the payer's agreed rate.

agreementName.description: The rate agreement that priced the lines, when one runs.

ledgerMinor.description: The visit's charges, void ones left out, at list price.

rateAdjustmentMinor.description: Rated total less ledger total; negative when the agreement is cheaper.

stale.description: A saved split exists and the ledger has changed since.

claimedMinor.description: The payer share of the visit split when the claim was prepared.

approvedMinor.description: What the payer agreed to pay. Absent until approved.

outstandingMinor.description: Claimed less received and written off, worked out by the server. Zero for a draft or a withdrawn claim.

openQuery.description: The payer question while the claim is in query.

documents.description: The packet, by name. The files are on the patient record.

allowedActions.description: What can be done to the claim now, from the state machine.

note.description: Required for raise_query (the question), reply, reject and write_off (the reason).

receivedMinor.description: Required for settle: the payment that came in, at most the approved amount.

documents.description: Added to the packet with a reply.

buckets.description: Outstanding money aged 0 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90 and over 90 days from submission.
Outstanding money aged 0 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90 and over 90 days from submission.
